-T ps_6_6 -E test1 repro.hlsl

# This is the configuration a maintainer published for this issue: llvm-beanz's
# Compiler Explorer link (2024-10-01, https://godbolt.org/z/xr6nv5z89) compiles the
# issue body's snippet in two dxc_trunk panes, "-T ps_6_6 -E test1" and
# "-T ps_6_6 -E test2".  The issue body itself gives no command line at all.
#
# cmd.txt lowers the profile to ps_6_0 for one reason only: ps_6_6 did not exist
# before 2021, so every release older than SM 6.6 would be an invalid probe and the
# release history would stop at the point where the profile was added rather than
# where the behaviour changed.  ps_6_0 is accepted by every catalogued release back
# to v1.4.1907.
#
# The change is not assumed inert, it is measured:
#   variant-asfiled-ps66-main-debug.txt   -T ps_6_6 -E test1   --expect match
#   variant-ps62-main-debug.txt           -T ps_6_2 -E test1   --expect match
# The only difference the profile makes is which DXIL op the StructuredBuffer load
# lowers to -- dx.op.bufferLoad (opcode 68) at SM 6.0/6.1, dx.op.rawBufferLoad
# (opcode 139) at SM 6.2 and above, which is what the reporter's own quoted IR
# shows.  The control-flow shape the issue is about is identical in all three.
# match.json's regex matches both spellings for exactly this reason.
